bio: In the heart of Marino’s historic centre, this venue distinguishes itself through a simple, modern, and minimalist aesthetic, accompanied by a gastronomic proposal that is almost entirely vegetarian. The menu, concise and carefully composed, offers a select number of dishes from which to choose freely, all built around plant-based ingredients.The young chef, talented and creative, works with precision on vegetables, pulses, and fruit, combining them in preparations of bold and at times complex flavour, capable of winning over even the most traditional of palates. The commitment to quality is absolute: only fresh produce is used, selected and prepared daily according to the number of guests, in a spirit of rigour and respect for the raw material. For this reason, the restaurant operates exclusively by reservation, guaranteeing a bespoke experience without compromise.
